headline: Vulcan Materials (VMC) Stock Could Be 21% Overvalued As Cash Flow Leads The Debate
summary: Vulcan Materials stock has delivered a gain of 54.3% over the past five years, yet both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples currently point to the shares trading at a premium rather than at a clear bargain. Vulcan Materials has returned 54.3% over five years, which rewards long term holders but raises the question of how much upside is already reflected in the price. Expectations for continued cash generation from aggregates and construction materials...
